description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class in GuzzleHttp, implementing a middleware component that retries HTTP requests based on a custom decision function. It manages retry logic, delay calculation, and integrates with promise-based asynchronous request handling.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages request retries with customizable backoff delay, relying on user-provided logic for retry decisions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a decider function, next handler, and optional delay function.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing a default exponential delay in milliseconds based on retry count.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles execution of the middleware, invoking the next handler and attaching fulfillment and rejection callbacks.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Creates a callback for successful responses that determines whether to retry based on the decider.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Creates a callback for failed responses that determines whether to retry based on the decider.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs the retry by incrementing retries, calculating delay, and re-invoking the middleware.
